school.school_name: 専門学校新国際福祉カレッジ

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a FY2026 target confirmation form embedded in a dated WordPress information post.
search_queries: 専門学校新国際福祉カレッジ 機関要件確認申請書
専門学校新国際福祉カレッジ 令和8年度 様式第2号
steps: Scroll to the section 大学等における修学の支援に関する法律第7条第1項の確認に係る情報.
Prefer the link labeled 令和８年度機関要件確認申請書20250718（様式第２号）.
Ignore adjacent 令和７年度 and 令和６年度 links unless running a stale-year control.
Accept the WordPress upload PDF only for FY2026 strict mode.

reusable_rules: Search results may land on a dated information post rather than a stable /information page.
Within WordPress posts, section headings around 修学の支援 and 機関要件 are stronger signals than opaque upload filenames.
When multiple Reiwa-year target-form links appear, choose the exact requested fiscal year and keep older links as stale controls.
anti_patterns: Do not choose adjacent 事業計画, 役員名簿, 財務, or 自己評価 PDFs from the same post.
Do not infer the year from the /uploads/2025/ path; use the visible 令和８年度 anchor text.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the FY2026 link text in a WordPress disclosure post; the PDF URL itself is opaque and needs anchor-context evidence.
